why: Post-2024 papers claim progress on threefold cases in positive characteristic (nu=2, char>3) and mixed characteristic, and completion of the Kahler threefold case, which could be settlements of cases of the stated conjecture or could be variants in a different category/field than the Wikipedia statement intends; the general klt conjecture in arbitrary dimension over the classical (char 0) setting remains open per all sources.
